verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair capability to ask of an LLM gateway, but the evidence pack documents no sandbox, mock, or test mode that keeps work isolated from production. Traffic mirroring (litellm-docs-39) is an adjacent feature: it copies live production traffic to a silent model for evaluation, which is the opposite of isolating tests from production data. Virtual keys and budgets are separate controls and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
